query: Sabores Centro Americano, Little Havana, FL
name: Sabores Centro Americano
hours: Monday (Labor Day), Closed, Hours might differ

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Andrew S
reviewSamples.text: We ordered a birria quesadilla and birria pupusa tacos. Excellent flavor, generous portions, friendly staff. Great roadside find.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Darma Andino
reviewSamples.text: The food is amazing and the staff are incredible. Have been ordering from them for a while since the NW 20th street location and I have no complaint.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Claudia Moreno
reviewSamples.text: I ordered the carne asada and pupusas. I’m happy I found this place because they serve good and very fresh food. The queso frito was really good and fresh. Would recommend to try this place.
